burrata.name: Burrata & tomat pusaka
burrata.short: Burrata krim, tomat mateng, sourdough panggang.
burrata.description: Werni alus saka burrata seger, tomat pusaka manis lan basil, rampung karo lenga zaitun. Tumis nganggo sourdough panggang sing anget.
burrata.ingredients: Burrata (susu), tomat, basil, lenga zaitun, sourdough (gandum), uyah segara.

dumplings.name: Pangsit cili
dumplings.short: Pangsit sayuran emas, lenga cabe, scallions.
dumplings.description: Enem pangsit sayuran pan-seared karo ngisor garing lan tengah alus. Rampung karo lenga cabe lan scallions, karo soy dipping sauce ing sisih.
dumplings.ingredients: Bungkus gandum, kol, jamur, wortel, bawang bombay, kecap (kedelai, gandum), wijen, minyak cabe.

pasta.name: Tomat lan basil rigatoni
pasta.short: Tomat sing dipanggang alon-alon, kemangi seger, parmesan.
pasta.description: Ridged pasta dibuwang ing sugih, alon-panggang sauce tomat, karo basil seger lan vegetarian parmesan. Nyaman, prasaja, lan digawe kanggo nedha awan sing dawa.
pasta.ingredients: Rigatoni (gandum), tomat, basil, parmesan vegetarian (susu), lenga zaitun, bawang putih.

salad.name: Mangkok taman panggang
salad.short: Sayuran panggang, kacang buncis, jeruk & jamu.
salad.description: Beets panggang lan kentang manis liwat sayuran ijo asri, karo chickpeas, jeruk padhang lan Jamu seger. A klamben lemon ndadekke kabeh bebarengan.
salad.ingredients: Beets, kentang manis, chickpeas, jeruk, sayuran ijo, parsley, mint, wijen, lemon, lenga zaitun.

chicken.name: Ayam Lemon & Jamu
chicken.short: Ayam emas, kentang bayi, kacang ijo.
chicken.description: Ayam panggang jamu kanthi kulit garing, kentang bayi lan kacang ijo. Disedhiyakake karo jus lemon lan lenga zaitun sing entheng.
chicken.ingredients: Pitik, kentang, kacang ijo, lemon, lenga zaitun, rosemary, thyme, bawang putih.

cake.name: Kue coklat ganache
cake.short: Coklat peteng, krim vanilla, raspberry seger.
cake.description: A irisan sugih saka coklat lapisan cake karo ganache coklat peteng nggilap. A krim vanilla sethitik lan raspberry seger ing sisih.
cake.ingredients: Coklat, glepung gandum, endhog, mentega (susu), krim (susu), gula, vanila, raspberry.

lemonade.name: Strawberry basil limun
lemonade.short: Stroberi seger, lemon, basil & banyu kemerlap.
lemonade.description: Lemonade sing padhang lan cerah kanthi stroberi seger, perasan lemon lan basil wangi. Disajikake liwat es.
lemonade.ingredients: Strawberry, lemon, basil, gula tebu, banyu kemerlap, es.

tea.name: Es teh jasmine
tea.short: Teh kembang melati, lemon, es akeh.
tea.description: Teh melati sing anyar diseduh, digodhog lan disuguhake ing es karo lemon. Tanpa gula, kanthi sentuhan kembang sing lembut.
tea.ingredients: Teh melati, lemon, banyu sing disaring, es. Ngandhut kafein.
